harnesses.name: Google Antigravity Harness
harnesses.evaluativeLens: Multi-Agent Collaboration, Reactive Wakeup (No Polling), Generative UI Artifacts, and Strict Workspace Governance Adherence.

compilationHighlights.gemini-4-argon: Native synergy with Antigravity's reactive tool bus. 10M context enables whole-workspace ingestion without chunking. MoD sparse routing cuts latency on background file indexing.
compilationHighlights.cursor-grok-47: Fast single-file completion, but lacks native multi-agent message routing and generative artifact rendering.
compilationHighlights.chatgpt-61: Excellent mathematical reasoning, but synchronous test-time compute delays violate reactive wakeup paradigms.
compilationHighlights.project-astra-2026: Ideal continuous pair-programming sensor companion; easily interfaces as an external observer agent.
compilationHighlights.claude-55-suite: Claude 5.5 Sonnet operates seamlessly as a delegated code subagent. 5.1 Fable is unmatched for research auditing.
compilationHighlights.muse-models-2026: Exceptional for rendering live Generative UI inline widgets in under 50ms.

harnessRanking.verdict: Highest architectural alignment with workspace mesh and multi-agent delegation.
Highest instruction adherence; essential for precision git diffs.
Premier formal theorem prover, but heavy latency overhead.
Blazing fast editor completions, but isolated from multi-agent messaging.
Perceptual powerhouse; secondary for repository engineering.
Unrivaled frontend prototyping speed, weaker on complex backend invariants.

harnesses.name: Claude Code Terminal Harness
harnesses.evaluativeLens: Autonomous Multi-Turn Git Repo Refactoring, Surgical Patch Minimality, Strict Rule Adherence over 50+ Turns, and Resistance to Sycophancy.

compilationHighlights.gemini-4-argon: Massive context allows reading full monorepos, but occasional safety fence false-refusals interrupt autonomous bash tool loops.
compilationHighlights.cursor-grok-47: Fast generation speed, but generates looser git diffs with occasional extraneous formatting mutations.
compilationHighlights.chatgpt-61: High reasoning rigor, but token cost scales steeply during iterative 40-step test-debug cycles.
compilationHighlights.project-astra-2026: Low utility in headless CLI environments; spatial/video capabilities are wasted in terminal pipelines.
compilationHighlights.claude-55-suite: The native benchmark leader. 5.5 Sonnet produces surgical minimal diffs; 5.1 Fable ensures rigorous review without sycophancy.
compilationHighlights.muse-models-2026: Parallel token generation struggles with terminal line-by-line diff formatting and subtle semantic edge cases.

harnessRanking.verdict: Native perfection: surgical diffs, 0% rule regression, and minimal test breakage.
Strong reasoning when self-correcting test failures, but high API cost.
Great repository ingestion; occasional refusal friction on sensitive code.
Fast drafting, but requires closer human supervision on complex diffs.
Poor fit for headless diff generation and compiler-driven iteration.
Terminal mismatch; designed for live audio/visual streams.

harnesses.name: Codex / Operator Harness
harnesses.evaluativeLens: Deep Formal Logic Verification, Python REPL Self-Correction, Test-Time Compute Budgeting, and Scientific Hypothesis Formulation.

compilationHighlights.gemini-4-argon: High performance when paired with Python tools; 10M context simplifies complex biological and physics datasets.
compilationHighlights.cursor-grok-47: Grok 4.7 Reasoning is capable, but lacks the formal theorem proving depth of o4.
compilationHighlights.chatgpt-61: The native benchmark champion. o4's Monte-Carlo Tree Search systematically eliminates logic errors before answering.
compilationHighlights.project-astra-2026: Sensory data is rich, but lacks the rigorous mathematical symbolic engines required for formal verification.
compilationHighlights.claude-55-suite: Claude 5.5 Opus is formidable in philosophical and biomedical synthesis, rivaling o4 in conceptual depth.
compilationHighlights.muse-models-2026: Diffusion architecture fails to maintain state across iterative formal logic proofs.

harnessRanking.verdict: Unrivaled test-time search and formal mathematical proof verification.
Superb qualitative rigor and precise execution logic.
Excellent tool execution and massive context ingestion.
Fast completion, but lower verification depth on non-coding formal logic.
Incapable of multi-step formal proof backtracking.
Embodied sensor specialist; limited symbolic reasoning capacity.

harnesses.name: Cursor IDE Agent Harness
harnesses.evaluativeLens: Interactive Typing Flow, In-Memory AST Indexing, 40ms Speculative Latency, Inline Ghost Text, and Multi-File Project Sync.

compilationHighlights.gemini-4-argon: Good for full-repo indexing, but API latency is too slow for 40ms inline ghost-text completions.
compilationHighlights.cursor-grok-47: The native benchmark champion. Speculative decoding delivers 145 tok/s with deep AST symbol integration.
compilationHighlights.chatgpt-61: o4 is too sluggish for interactive editing; 6.1 Pro is decent but lacks Cursor's tight compiler diff hooks.
compilationHighlights.project-astra-2026: Fantastic when used as a side-by-side screen assistant explaining errors visually.
compilationHighlights.claude-55-suite: Claude 5.5 Sonnet is the #1 preferred engine for Composer / multi-file agentic refactoring.
compilationHighlights.muse-models-2026: Instantaneous UI generation makes it the ultimate frontend mockup accelerator inside the editor.

harnessRanking.verdict: Native home-field advantage: 145 tok/s speculative completion with 0-latency flow.
The undisputed king of complex multi-file architectural refactoring.
Revolutionary speed for instant UI/Tailwind/HTML preview synthesis.
Great background context engine, too high latency for inline editing.
Too high latency and cost for continuous editor session usage.
Best as an external visual companion rather than the core code editor engine.

harnesses.name: Grok Bot Harness
harnesses.evaluativeLens: Zero False-Refusal Friction, Direct Hardware Utilization, Adversarial Security Analysis, and Unfiltered Code Synthesis.

compilationHighlights.gemini-4-argon: High capability marred by overly protective safety filters that halt benign cybersecurity code auditing.
compilationHighlights.cursor-grok-47: The native benchmark champion. Completely unfiltered, high-velocity, and uncompromising on developer autonomy.
compilationHighlights.chatgpt-61: Strong reasoning, but burdened by heavy alignment sanitization on raw system-level scripts.
compilationHighlights.project-astra-2026: Impressive real-time sensor engine, though bound by corporate guardrail stacks.
compilationHighlights.claude-55-suite: Claude 5.5 Sonnet is highly respected for coding, but Constitutional bounds can occasionally hesitate on edge-case testing.
compilationHighlights.muse-models-2026: Fast generation speed, but architectural limitations prevent serious binary or system-level security analysis.

harnessRanking.verdict: Native ideological alignment: zero false refusals, max hardware speed, pure developer freedom.
Superb coding competence; minimal refusal interference in practical development.
Strong reasoning, but paternalistic safety filters trigger on low-level exploits.
Powerful hardware backing hampered by safety layer sensitivity.
Fast UI toy; inadequate for deep systems programming.
Sensory assistant with high latency and heavy cloud guardrails.
